import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
import statsmodels.formula.api as smf

# 1. Load clinical data and preprocess mitotic count
clin = pd.read_csv('cleaned_clinical_data.csv', dtype={'bcr_patient_barcode': str})
clin['mitotic_count_per_mm2'] = pd.to_numeric(clin['mitotic_count_per_mm2'], errors='coerce')
clin_sub = clin[['bcr_patient_barcode', 'mitotic_count_per_mm2', 'age_at_diagnosis', 'gender']]
clin_sub = clin_sub.dropna(subset=['mitotic_count_per_mm2'])

# 2. Load gene expression and compute per-patient average
expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)
# Map sample barcodes to patient barcodes (first 12 chars)
patient_ids = [col[:12] for col in expr.columns]
expr.columns = patient_ids
expr_pt = expr.groupby(axis=1, level=0).mean()

# 3. Extract MKI67 expression (Ensembl ENSG00000148773)
ensembl_id = 'ENSG00000148773'
mask = expr_pt.index.str.startswith(ensembl_id)
if not mask.any():
    raise ValueError(f"MKI67 Ensembl ID {ensembl_id} not found in expression data.")
mki67_series = expr_pt.loc[mask].iloc[0]
mki67_df = mki67_series.reset_index()
mki67_df.columns = ['bcr_patient_barcode', 'MKI67_expr']

# 4. Merge clinical mitotic count with MKI67 expression
merged = pd.merge(clin_sub, mki67_df, on='bcr_patient_barcode')
print(f"Merged dataset: {len(merged)} patients with mitotic count and MKI67 expression.")
print(merged[['bcr_patient_barcode','mitotic_count_per_mm2','MKI67_expr']].head(10))

# 5. Spearman correlation
rho, pval = spearmanr(merged['mitotic_count_per_mm2'], merged['MKI67_expr'])
print(f"\nSpearman correlation between mitotic count and MKI67 expression:")
print(f"  rho = {rho:.3f}, p-value = {pval:.3e}\n")

# 6. Linear regression adjusting for age and gender
reg_df = merged.dropna(subset=['age_at_diagnosis', 'gender'])
model = smf.ols('MKI67_expr ~ mitotic_count_per_mm2 + age_at_diagnosis + C(gender)', data=reg_df).fit()
print("Linear regression results:")
print(f"  R-squared: {model.rsquared:.3f}")
# Print coefficients and p-values
coef_table = model.summary().tables[1]
print(coef_table)

# 7. Scatter plot with regression line
plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4))
sns.regplot(x='mitotic_count_per_mm2', y='MKI67_expr', data=merged,
            scatter_kws={'alpha': 0.6}, line_kws={'color': 'red'})
plt.xlabel('Mitotic Count per mm²')
plt.ylabel('MKI67 Expression (log2 FPKM)')
plt.title('MKI67 Expression vs Mitotic Count')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
